subject.title: PR Limit Update: Why We Now Cap at 20 Open PRs Per Author

question: Should the 20-open-PR cap remain as a pinned locked GitHub issue, or should the policy live only in CONTRIBUTING.md and automation?
rationale: The source implementation is complete, but a maintainer intentionally renamed, pinned, and reopened the issue afterward, so automation cannot safely infer the intended announcement lifecycle.

options.title: Keep pinned notice
options.body: Leave the issue open and pinned as the public policy notice while continuing to keep docs and automation in sync.

options.title: Move to docs-only
options.body: Unpin and close the issue after confirming CONTRIBUTING.md and automation are the only desired public policy surfaces.

options.title: Replace with another announcement surface
options.body: Close this issue only after moving the notice to a discussion, docs page, or other maintainer-owned announcement channel.

recommendation.title: Keep pinned notice
recommendation.body: Leave the issue open and pinned as the public policy notice while continuing to keep docs and automation in sync.

likelyOwner.reason: Takhoffman performed the post-implementation rename, pin, and reopen actions that make this a policy-lifecycle decision.
